items.title: Can NFLX Stock Compound Its Way Higher?
items.summary: While the market focuses on streaming wars, a different category is quietly inflecting inside the business. Monthly players for cloud games have increased 11x since last October. This adoption is already outpacing the company's earlier push into mobile games, suggesting a new engagement engine is taking hold.

items.title: Disney Selling 50% A+E Stake To Hearst For More Than $1B
items.summary: The midsized cable TV network group, including A&E Network, History Channel, Lifetime, Vice TV and others, would now be 100% owned by Hearst. The deal is expected to be finalized at the same time as Disney's quarterly earnings release on August 5.

items.title: NBCUniversal names new CFO ahead of spinoff
